misfits: lightning
In Mid a summer storm's lightning sets wooden buildings on fire. You held 'fire from a strike' for later (Dictionary, Climate). Bring it now with fire, or keep it held?
strike
Same call as lightning: v100 already draws the bolt; only the fire it starts is held.
natureTick

Mid throws a lightning strike on open ground every 20 s of a summer storm from here. v100 already has its own strikes on a timer (D113), so this part would be a second one; the rest (tired soil, trade routes paying) is fine.
workMul
Mid's villagers also work faster when 'cheered by the circus'. You cut the circus (fantasy events, Nov 4), so that part drops; sickness and famine stay. OK?
step
Mid's step turns night on during an eclipse. You cut the eclipse, so that line drops. Just confirming.
seasonTurn
Food spoiling in store each season: your v70 list held 'spoiling stockpiles' for later, but the v100 Dictionary lists spoilage under Later (kept). Bring it with the seasons, or keep it held?
vassalTick
Vassals pay their lord a tax (light, fair or heavy), and heavy tax breeds unrest. You said 'not looking to add taxes' (Nov 4). Does that cover a vassal's tax to you, or only taxing your own people?
makeVassal
Same tax question: a new vassal is made with a tax rate.
judge
Mid has a win by holding the Throne for some minutes. You want the Throne reimagined before it comes back. Keep this win for the new Throne, or wait until you describe it?
formUp

Mid stands the army in ranks (foot in front, shooters behind, battalions side by side), which is a formation. You held the formations' definitions for yourself. Use Mid's ranks as the at-home stand, or wait for your formations?
setRel

Relations between sides (ally, peace, war) and vassal ties belong to the sides, not to any one shell, and v100 has no home for side-to-side state yet. Where should it live: a new Sides book, or the Rules book?
paceOf

Mid slows walkers for load, sickness, season, weather and more, on top of each unit's base speed. In v100 the base walk is 1.52 m/s (D86); these would only slow it from there. OK to bring the slow-downs as they are?
